text:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — I'm bringing up calypso-11b on staging for a fast perf pass. Goal: quick latency + throughput sweep and a couple quant baselines (int8 AWQ, GPTQ-4x2). Targets: ctx 512/1024/2048, batch 1/4/8. Can someone own the run today? I'll coordinate rollouts and collate results.

Anya: I can own the eval side. I'll prepare ~200 mixed prompts (QA + short dialogs + code completions). We'll need p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, mem RSS, and a simple quality score over the eval set (exact-match / chrF for code). Ping me the model path when it's up. :+1:

Derek: I can run quant experiments. Plan: PTQ AWQ-128 as baseline and GPTQ-4x2 for a tighter size/quality tradeoff. Quick commands I'll use on the bench image:
```bash
# AWQ - per-channel, 128 block
bench quant --model /models/calypso-11b --method awq --block-size 128 --out /tmp/calypso-awq-128
# GPTQ-4x2
bench quant --model /models/calypso-11b --method gptq --bits 4 --groupsize 128 --out /tmp/calypso-gptq-4x2
```
Also will capture a small perplexity delta on the eval set to flag regressions. I'll tag outputs with git sha and timestamp.

Sasha: I'm standing up runs on g5-16x (staging pool). Notes: warmup matters for kv cache—I'll do 10 warmup requests before measuring. Running ctx sweep now: 512 / 1024 / 2048 with batch 1/4/8. Starting with FP16 baseline, then AWQ, then GPTQ. I'll post raw CSVs.

BenchBot: automated perf summary (from initial quick pass):
- FP16 | ctx=512 | batch=1  -> p50=62ms p95=180ms tokens/sec=1200 mem=22.1GB
- FP16 | ctx=1024| batch=1  -> p50=95ms p95=320ms tokens/sec=1050 mem=23.4GB
- FP16 | ctx=2048| batch=1  -> p50=210ms p95=610ms tokens/sec=930  mem=25.8GB
- AWQ   | ctx=512 | batch=1  -> p50=68ms p95=210ms tokens/sec=1180 mem=11.2GB
- GPTQ4 | ctx=512 | batch=1  -> p50=75ms p95=240ms tokens/sec=1160 mem=7.1GB
(collector: bench-2024-06-xx, node=g5-16x, warmup=10)

Anya: early quality look on the 200 prompts (sampling disabled for fair compare):
- FP16 exact-match: 81.2%
- AWQ-128 exact-match: 80.1% (delta -1.1)
- GPTQ-4x2 exact-match: 78.9% (delta -2.3)
I'll upload detailed diffs but nothing alarming yet; watch for hallucination increase on code snippets.

Morgan: great — thanks team. Next steps: Derek keep both quant artifacts and model metadata in /artifacts/calypso/; Sasha share CSV heatmaps; Anya upload eval diffs. If p95 at batch=1 ctx=512 exceeds 450ms or exact-match delta > 5%, we'll flag for follow-up before any hosted rollout. I'll assemble a short checklist from today's run and open a follow-up thread for optimization tasks. :mag_right:
